task_name: On ohio.gov or its official subdomains, find and open the instructions for obtaining an initial Athletic Trainer license in Ohio. Leave open the licensing instructions or the official initial-license application rule, with the application procedure visible.

source.original_task_name: Find the procedure to get the license for Athletic Trainer.
source.intent_modified_reason: "Find the procedure" became opening the instructions for an initial application in Ohio. Official licensing instructions and same-jurisdiction rules are accepted; nothing has to be submitted.
